correctness.rationale: The integral Tuffley cellular chain ring, after rational differential rescaling δb_i=a_i, has degree-four cycles of pair-supported a_i a_j b_i/b_j, two triple-supported kernels per i<j<k, and exterior fourfold cycles. The pure generator b_i->b_i-2a_i a_j, b_j->b_j+2a_i a_j kills pairs and fourfolds; on triple cycles maps into fourfold exterior and their products vanish. A linear combination acts zero iff for every triple {i,j,k} and outside l one has c_il=c_jl=c_kl. For n>=4 connectivity of these comparisons forces all coefficients equal; the primitive diagonal Z relation gives torsion-free Z^{C(n,2)-1}. For n<=3 fourfold output is absent. Independent correction matrix rank mod prime for n=2..8 is (0,0,5,9,14,20,27) and verifies all-ones relation, but integral saturation comes from the symbolic primitive-diagonal kernel, not a mod-p test.
